description: This file defines custom matchers and utilities for Playwright's expect API, including proxy-based matcher creation, polling support, and test step integration.

classes.name: ExpectMetaInfoProxyHandler
classes.description: Proxy handler for managing expectation metadata, including matcher resolution and polling support.

methods.name: createMatchers
methods.description: Creates a proxy for matchers with attached expectation info and prefix.

methods.name: qualifiedMatcherName
methods.description: Generates a qualified matcher name based on qualifier array and matcher name.

methods.name: createExpect
methods.description: Creates a proxy-based expect object with support for extension, soft expectations, polling, and configuration.

methods.name: setMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Sets the current context for matcher calls, including test info and step.

methods.name: takeMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the current matcher call context.

methods.name: wrapPlaywrightMatcherToPassNiceThis
methods.description: Wraps a matcher to pass Playwright-specific context and timeout handling.

methods.name: throwUnsupportedExpectMatcherError
methods.description: Throws an error for unsupported custom matchers.

methods.name: pollMatcher
methods.description: Performs polling for a matcher until timeout or success.

methods.name: computeArgsSuffix
methods.description: Computes suffix string for matcher arguments, e.g., for screenshots.
